title: PathJev: Decision-Native Vision-Language Modelling for Histopathology
abstract: arXiv:2610.32478v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-language models used for decisions in histopathology rarely return calibrated probabilities over the candidates a user cares about. Decision-native models write a question and a candidate set chosen at run time into the input and return a normalised distribution from a small decision head in one forward pass. We build PathJev-P, a decision-native model for histopathology: MedGemma-1.5-4B with LoRA adapters and a decision head, trained on 40,000 patch states from three public collections whose expert labels are turned into typed questions with organ-specific candidate sets and a "none of these" option. In a comparison over 3 seeds with an analysis plan fixed before testing, on test sets without documented overlap with the training data of the backbone, PathJev-P is more accurate than a generative model trained with the same backbone, data and selection rule, the zero-shot pathology model CONCH and a general medical decision model

translated_title: PathJev：面向组织病理学的决策原生视觉语言建模
translated_abstract: 用于组织病理学决策的视觉语言模型很少能针对用户关心的候选类别返回校准良好的概率。决策原生模型将运行时选定的问题和候选集合写入输入，并在一次前向传播中通过一个小型决策头返回归一化的概率分布。我们构建了 PathJev-P，一个面向组织病理学的决策原生模型：基于 MedGemma-1.5-4B，配备 LoRA 适配器和一个决策头，在来自三个公开数据集的 40,000 个切片补丁状态上训练，并将专家标注转换为带有器官特异性候选集合和“以上都不是”选项的类型化问题。在一项基于 3 个随机种子、且分析方案在测试前预先固定的对比实验中，在与骨干模型训练数据无已记录重叠的测试集上，PathJev-P 的准确率超过了使用相同骨干、数据和选择规则训练的生成式模型、零样本病理模型 CONCH 以及一个通用医疗决策模型。
tldr: PathJev-P 是一个决策原生的组织病理学视觉语言模型，通过在输入中嵌入运行时问题和候选集合并经小型决策头一次前向传播输出归一化概率分布，在无数据重叠的测试集上准确率超越同骨干生成式模型、零样本病理模型 CONCH 和通用医疗决策模型。
en_tdlr: PathJev-P is a decision-native vision-language model for histopathology that embeds a runtime question and candidate set into the input and returns a normalized probability distribution from a small decision head in one forward pass, outperforming a same-backbone generative model, the zero-shot pathology model CONCH, and a general medical decision model on non-overlapping test sets.
